content.text:
Built and rendered — all three sizes clean, no defects.

- **Structure:** one full-canvas column stack, so the photo band and red CTA bar run edge-to-edge at every size; the three candidates sit in equal `flexGrow` columns (evenly spaced at 312 / 359 px wide).
- **Photo:** `fit: cover` with centered focus, so it crops (1600×533 portrait, 1600×317 wide, 1600×597 sky) instead of distorting.
- **Per-size adaptation:** `media` overrides shrink the band for the short wide canvas (280px) and, for the 300×600 skyscraper, stack the candidates vertically and scale type up so the smallest text stays at 11.8px rather than 7px.

Renders: `portrait-v6.png` (1080×1350), `wide-v6.png` (1200×1000), `sky-v6.png` (300×600).
